A '''leader''' led a [[Unidentified pirate group (Sayblohn)|group]] of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sayblohn]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The pirate [[Death/Legends|murdered]] an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Unidentified Alliance contact|contact]] and stole an art object of religious significance to the [[Okfili]].<ref name="RPG" /> An [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|Alliance Special Operations]] team<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|406|Ofkili}}</ref> raided the pirate's [[Sayblohn pirate base|base]] in the badlands and recovered the artifact.<ref name="RPG" />
